// Find attempts to stop processes using taskkill.exe
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where FileName =~ "taskkill.exe"
| summarize taskKillCount = dcount(ProcessCommandLine), TaskKillList =
make_set(ProcessCommandLine) by DeviceId, bin(Timestamp, 2m)
| where taskKillCount > 10
